nom: Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum

avis.texte: This is NOT for those with sensitive skin. Tried this out one night - next morning had a swollen eye and red hives all over my face and neck.

avis.titre: Wanted to like it but no...
avis.texte: This felt really nice going on and was smooth and refreshing. However, within seconds of it being on, it was completely sticky. I thought maybe it would be short lived so I left it, hours later and STILL sticky. I finally went and washed it off. Made it a total no for me.

avis.titre: Everything about this is good for your skin
avis.texte: I really enjoy using this product because it leaves my skin feeling hydrated, moisturized (protected), even toned, and fresh (exfoliated). This has glycolic acid (gently exfoliates), transexemic acid (brightens/soothes/clears out pores), hexapeptide 2 (smooths lines/we love a peptide over here), and glycerin and urea (pulls moisture from the air around you into your skin). This also has amino acids. Honestly, this product has it all. It balances my skin while nourishing and exfoliating it. Its so gentle for sensitive skin. I absolutely love this stuff! Your skin will thank you.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love this serum. Always healthy to use a serum and this one feels great on the skin and comes out easily. The color is clear and absorbs into the skin well. It helps clear the skin and minimize dark spots

Amazing product for those with oily skin. I had a lot of dark spots due to acne and after a month of applying I did see a big improvement they became much lighter so the more your consistence with it the better it works also use with suncream!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I suffer from dark spots on my face and since I have been using Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum the dark spot have gotten light. My skin did not get irritated not peeling . You have to use it consistently in order for it to work.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great staple serum to add to your skincare routine! I love the texture of this- it is not too runny and not too thick of a serum either. This has helped fade my discoloration tremendously and I am pleased with it!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It's hard to tell exactly how well this works, as I haven't been super consistent with it. It's a tad tacky to the touch, but after applying moisturizer it's not noticeable. So I'll have to test this out for longer.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My skin has never looked more radiant than ever after using this product since day one that I received since I wanted to put to the test, it helped my hyperpigmentation and dull skin now looks vibrant, will definitely be repurchasing

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I absolutely love this product! The texture is so smooth and really feels like it absorbs directly into your skin. It is so easy to apply and a little goes a long way with this product!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I just want to say this works absolutely miracles on my dark spots. I've been using for quite a while now, and seeing a drastic improvement and as little as two weeks of using. I've tried many products, but nothing works quite like the Murad Environmental Shield Dark Spot Correcting Serum. I like that is non-harsh on my skin and does not irritate it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] First of all I love there is no vitamin c scent with this. I usually they have a metallic scent to it. This is perfect and finally helped a spot on my cheek that has been there for 2 years. It still there but extremely faint now.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great serum. It goes on easily and is not greasy. It spreads well. I did not get any breakouts from it and it was not irritating. I didnt get any drying of my skin either. It was the consistency of gel. Great product.

This serum is absolutely fantastic. No weird smell, a gel texture, absorbs quickly into the skin. Is not sticky or heavy feeling, definitely see results if you use consistently. As usual, Murad knocked this one out of the park!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The serum works well, if you use it regularly, it's lightweight and absorbs easily. Good price, worth every penny. The formula feels gentle but effective, and its layers really well under moisturizer and make up. Love the scent. After using it consistently, I noticed my dark spots fading and my skin tone looking brighter.

avis.titre: Great addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love Murad and have really liked the products I have used from this brand, so I was excited to try this serum. The packaging is sleek and easy to use, the serum has a light clean scent that is not overpowering, I did not experience any irritation when using this serum. It has been a great addition to my skincare routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm not sure that I really care for this product. It makes my face feel sticky after application, and I don't see any difference after using it. Not a favorite.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum consistently for about a month and have really been enjoying it so far. The texture is smooth and slightly slippery, which makes it spread effortlessly across the skin, and a little truly goes a long way. My skin absorbs it quickly and I've experienced zero pilling when layering other products on top. It doesn't have a noticeable scent, which I actually appreciate, and it hasn't irritated my skin at all. I use it daily and haven't experienced any dryness—in fact my skin feels a bit fuller and healthier overall. I don't have many dark spots, mostly leftover acne marks, and while they aren't completely gone, I do think they appear lighter after consistent use. Considering how little product you need each time, the bottle should last quite a while which adds good value. I plan to continue using it and will likely purchase another bottle to see what another month of use can do.

avis.titre: A must in your skincare routine
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Wow ! I was highly impressed with this product and cannot believe how fast I've been seeing results. I have never really been a skincare girly but I have learned the importance of taking care of our skin. I had a lot of dark pigmentation on my cheeks and this serum has helped so much. My skin also use to look very dull and this has helped even out my skin tone and really brighten it. The serum itself is not sticky and glides on the skin smoothly. I really love that it also helps prevent any further dark spots which is definitely a plus.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how lightweight the serum is, it feels weightless after drying and it adds a layer of protection. It works efficiently to treat dark areas and spots over time. The formula is gentle for sensitive skin, it actually feels soothing. The consistency is light and runny, but viscous enough to create a nice layer on the skin. It absorbs evenly and easily.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This serum was lightweight and not too fragranced. It worked on some minor dark spots but only minimally on some older ones. I will keep using this to see what happens.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Incentivized - good product - the only drawback - upon the first application - it does create a bit of a sensation - after using it a few times - it was fine. It effectively removed dark circles

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using this serum consistently for about 2 weeks focusing on areas where I have uneven skin tone and small dark spots around my eyes and cheeks. The texture is lightweight, silky and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or heavy. What stood out to me was how bright and even my skin has started to look. I appreciate that it doesn't irritate my skin. No redness just a healthy glow. Though this is on the pricier side since I'm seeing results I highly recommend this if you're wanting to fade your dark spots and get a healthy glow. I don't have severe dark spots however so I can't attest to how well this will work for that.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This Murad serum feels good going on, absorbs quickly. It has a light pleasant scent. The serum is thicker, not watery, and I like that. The consistency is almost a runny gel serum. It literally does not have a scent either. I believe if you have melasma, dark spots, or fullness you are really gonna enjoy this serum.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This product made my skin look very shiny/glowy in a good way. When used with a moisturizer I didn't feel too dry, but using it more than once a day may dry some people's skin. Worth a try!!!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this dark spot correcting serum and the fact that it can be applied all over your face and not just target areas. Theres a slight chemical scent but it doesn't last long. So far no breakouts and I feel like it's really working for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I saw noticeable in my dark spots after using this serum. The serum is thin and soaks in quickly, so it works well with my routine. Results look promising so far. The only downside was the scent. It has a bit of a clinical smell that I didn't love.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a light weight serum. I love how a little goes a long way! One pump and I can use on my face and neck. The scene is pleasing. I feel like my dark spots have improved especially on my neck.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The his works ok. It helps a little bit but not enough to buy for me. The texture is creamy and works great on sensitive skin. It didn't cause any discomfort. It might work better for others than it did for me.

I've really seen a difference in my skins radiance and overall evenness of my complexion since incorporating this Murad serum into my daily routine. I typically use Vitamin C serums for this purpose so it was nice to try out something different. I've never used tranexamic acid before but was pleasantly surprised as its effectiveness in reducing skin discoloration. This, along with ingredients like glycolic acid and niacinamide, really have helped with keeping my skin exfoliated and bright, particularly a challenge in the winter months. Very pleased with the product so far - it layers well under other skincare products and makeup and has made a noticeable posititive change in my skins clarity and appearance.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The texture and consistency is quite nice , not overwhelming in smell as some vitamin c serums can be , being on the more sensitive skin side this didn't give me any issues and worked quite well to reduce a few post blemish marks . Considering some products with the same purpose can be highly irritating I'd opt for this one over others

A great beginner vitamin C serum. Not super powerful but still potent enough to combat dark spots. I love how gentle it is and that it doesn't contain fragrance. It hasn't bothered my skin at all. Also, it doesn't apply leaving a sticky, tacky feel and is great applied under makeup and sunscreen. "I receive this for my honest review"

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is definitely high quality, you can tell when it comes out the pump it's high quality because it has medical smell meaning your gonna get the best benefits from it . avis.titre: The first serum to fade my hyperpigmentation!
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Murad Dark Spot Correcting Serum has become a staple in my skincare routine. It's a lightweight serum that glides on smoothly and dries quickly without feeling sticky. The scent is fresh, almost citrusy, but not overpowering. It layers beautifully with my other skincare products without pilling, which I truly appreciate. Now for the most important part: it works wonders for hyperpigmentation. After about 6 weeks of consistent use, my hyperpigmentation is nearly gone! I've struggled with a big spot right on my cheekbone for years that I couldn't get to lighten, but since using this serum, the difference is amazing. It's faded from a dark brown to pink. It leaves my skin glowing and has helped tremendously with hormonal breakouts, all without any irritation! The best part is a little goes a long way. Due to the results I've experienced while using this serum, I wholeheartedly recommend it in any skincare routine.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Definitely a great serum, did not irritate my skin at all actually feels very nice!! Smells good as well. I will definitely be purchasing more in the future this is great for aging skin

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am absolutely loving the Murad brand skincare this year! avis.titre: Attacks dark spots like a boss
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love Murad's packaging, it's so sleek and eye pleasing. Of all my skincare the vibrancy of this bottle catches my eye every evening. With that said, I have been using this for a couple weeks now, and I can say that some of my dark spots have most definitely faded. I am really good with sunscreen so fortunately I don't have a lot of spots to contend with. I wanted to post a before and after but just couldn't get the lighting good enough for accuracy. So just take my word for it! The texture is a little tacky, which I feel is better for gripping onto the skin. There is no scent, which doesn't bother me either way. I naturally have dry skin, but didn't notice extra dryness in the areas I used it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Absolutely a great product to help reduce dark spots from being in the sun living in the south. It helps to reduce the amount of sun exposure I've had throughout the years. Goes on smoothly and is a light product. Drys quickly and is effective.

I received the Murad Rapia Dark Spot Correcting Serum and have been using it daily for several weeks. I really like the way it feels on my face and it makes my skin feel tight which I love. It absorbs fast and then I apply my moisturizer. I can't speak to it lightening any dark spots because I feel like I would need to use it much longer.

avis.titre: Consistency is different but great product overall
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest review. This product is different from others in its formulation. Its a very thick and sticky serum unlike anything ive used before. Its tacky thick and clear just like glue which is odd to me.. Also, it leaves a very thin layer wherever you apply it and can roll or peel off. Really the only way to apply it is on a very fresh face for it to soak into the skin. I gave this product the full 4 week period to see if it actuallv works and my answer is, Yes. I had a few dark spots from post acne marks and it took those away with consistent use nightly. After showering and everything I applied this first directly to the dark spots before applying my other skincare products over top. I noticed the dark spots getting less noticeable as the days carried on. Im happy to see continued results which aided in me knowing it was working and gave me a boost in dedication to keep applying it every night. The dark spots are almost completely gone now. I can say with full confidence that they should be completely lightened either within 4 weeks or by 4 weeks just due to how long it originally takes to get half way lightned.

avis.titre: Lightweight, cool, smells good, slightly effective
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum before and I liked it then and I still like it. First of all, it has a light citrus scent that does not linger. It is a clear serum type liquid that comes from a good, small pump that stays pretty clean. I have dark spots from sun exposure and tanning bed use in my teens, and I feel like this does lighten them up just a little. It does, however make my skin feel moisturized and seems to tighten my pores a little as well. I use it every AM and PM. It feels cool going on, but not always a tingling sensation unless I have exfoliated that day. I love Murad and have used it for over 10 years. I think the packaging is less impressive now than it used to be-they made the switch to some bigger bottles made with lightweight plastic that I feel makes it seem like there is more product than there really is, which doesn't make sense to me unless they are just wanting to make it seem like a better deal. I liked the old packaging from 10 years ago better. Overall, I would recommend this WITH other dark spot treatments, heavy sun protection, and ample moisturizer. It takes more than just one miracle product to keep the dark spots from getting worse. There is a before and after picture, the photo without the Murad bottle is about 1 month before and the photo with the Murad bottle is after consistent AM and PM daily use for about a month.
